failed: Operation failed. Check configuration and task revision.

prerequisites.evaluate: Configure the benchmark results root in component management, then place actual CommerceAgentBench artifacts in this tenant's private space directory.
prerequisites.memory: Memory operations use a separate bank for this tenant and private space. Configure the Hindsight endpoint and client first.
prerequisites.provenance: Export requires an installed Semantica module and a valid SQL evidence chain. Original SQL evidence remains authoritative.
prerequisites.evolution: Manual candidates can be created directly. RNA generation requires its local SDK and model; assessment and transitions require trusted operator reports.

unconfigured: This component is not configured. Complete its settings before performing this operation.
connectionUnknown: Local configuration does not establish remote health. The server rechecks configuration, authority, and task revision at execution.
adminRequired: This operation requires owner or admin membership in the current tenant. Global administrator status does not replace tenant authority.
permissionRequired: Sign in and confirm write access to this tenant.
verifiedMemoryRequired: Retaining memory requires independently confirmed goal achievement and valid source evidence. Node success or a benchmark pass cannot replace goal verification.
runDirHint: Enter a relative run path below this private space's results directory. Host absolute paths and parent traversal are not accepted.
benchmarkTaskHint: Optional. When provided, the server verifies the benchmark task ID in the manifest.
ttlHint: 60–31536000 seconds. Expired items are filtered on recall; there is no automatic background TTL cleaner.
deleteHint: Delete a memory document retained by this task. This calls the remote deletion endpoint and cannot be undone from this page.
trustedReports: The server reads gates from trusted operator reports. This page accepts no self-declared safety passes, scores, or Canary readiness.
inertCandidate: Candidate states record review and version decisions. They do not automatically deploy strategies or perform production business writes.
benchmarkRevisionHint: The fixed evaluation suite revision is frozen on creation. Candidates cannot change their evaluation standard.
proposalHint: Enter additional proposal fields only, such as updates to existing skills. Authority, tool assignments, policy gates, and evaluation standards are forbidden. Form summary and hypothesis take precedence.
baselineSkillsHint: The baseline uses skill snapshots frozen when this task was created. No tools or authority are added.
noFrozenSkills: This task has no frozen custom skills. It can still produce a strategy candidate.
candidateHint: Only candidates whose latest state allows this action are listed. The server still validates digests, baseline, and trusted reports.
provenanceHint: Index the complete verified evidence cut from before this export began, then confirm it by readback. This does not replace WORM storage or external notarization.
consentExport: I consent to exporting this task's verified execution evidence to Semantica.
consentRetain: I consent to retaining this verified, evidence-backed summary in this private space's Hindsight memory.
consentDelete: I confirm permanent deletion of this document and have checked the current task and document identifier.
confirmRna: I confirm sending this task's baseline and evidence to the configured model to propose a candidate. Model charges may apply.
confirmTransition: I have checked the current task, candidate, and frozen baseline and confirm recording this transition decision.
blocked: Candidate generation was blocked. Complete the component prerequisites.
recorded: Result recorded on the current task
noMemories: No memories meet source and expiry requirements
benchmarkScope: Execution health and benchmark outcome are separate. Benchmark scores do not establish this business goal or business uplift.

validation.runDirRequired: Enter a run directory of up to 400 characters
validation.relativeRunDir: Enter a path relative to this space, without an absolute path or parent traversal
validation.invalidNumber: The value must be an integer within the allowed range
validation.documentRequired: Enter a memory document ID belonging to this task
validation.verifiedMemoryRequired: This task lacks qualified goal verification and source evidence
validation.confirmRequired: Review and confirm this operation first
validation.proposalObject: Advanced input must be a valid JSON object
validation.proposalAuthority: Proposals cannot change authority, tool assignments, safety gates, or evaluation standards
validation.candidateActionInvalid: The latest candidate state does not allow this action. Refresh the task and retry.
